description: This Java source file defines the ContentMapFacade class, which implements a Map interface for content management within the OFBiz framework. It provides methods for accessing content fields, links, subcontent, metadata, and rendering content, along with internal classes for handling related data resources, subcontent, and metadata.

classes.name: Content
classes.description: Inner class representing content object, provides access to content fields and related content.

classes.name: SubContent
classes.description: Inner class managing subcontent items, supports filtering and sorting.

classes.name: MetaData
classes.description: Inner class for accessing content metadata.

classes.name: DataResource
classes.description: Inner class for accessing data resource details and rendering.

classes.name: AbstractInfo
classes.description: Abstract base class implementing Map, providing unimplemented methods with warnings.

methods.name: ContentMapFacade
methods.description: Constructor initializing ContentMapFacade with content entity, context, locale, mimeType, and cache settings.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order for subcontent.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves content properties, links, subcontent, metadata, or renders content based on key.

methods.name: renderThis
methods.description: Renders the content as text, considering decoration and recursion prevention.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the rendered content as string.
